1.text: Identify people and things
Meaning and sentence construction

Use person/thing + identity noun + a form of हो. A noun names a person or thing, such as student or book. In म विद्यार्थी हुँ, म means I, विद्यार्थी means student, and हुँ agrees with I. Use छ for location or condition instead. Initial के can mark a yes/no question. Use the होइन family for negatives.
Positive and negative forms for six basic person groups
उनी is not selected by gender alone. छन् can express medium respect; छिन् explicitly marks a feminine form. See topic 7. Note the nasal first-person negatives होइनँ/छैनँ.
The ending changes with the subject. Identity statements use the होइन family for negatives, not the छैन family.

The usual order is subject + object/place/time + verb. Nouns name entities, adjectives describe qualities, and verbs express actions or states. 4.text: Distinguish current state, regular situations and change
Meaning and sentence construction

छ describes a current condition; हुन्छ can express a regular situation or what happens. आज चिसो छ means it is cold today; जाडोमा चिसो हुन्छ describes winter generally. 7.text: Choose pronouns and verbs for the social relationship
Meaning and sentence construction

Ordinary practice prioritizes म, हामी, तपाईं, तपाईंहरू, उनी and उनीहरू. तँ has low respect and can sound rude outside very close relationships. तिमी is familiar; तपाईं is respectful. Verb agreement changes with the form chosen. Familiar does not simply mean speaking to someone inferior.
उ, उनी and उहाँ distinguish respect, not male versus female

29.text: Link people, things, places and times
Meaning and sentence construction

Nepali can modify a noun with a -ने/-एको clause, or link clauses with forms such as जो and जुन. जो commonly refers to a person, जुन selects an entity, and जे refers to content. जहाँ marks place, जता direction, जब/जहिले time, जसरी manner, and जति amount/degree. These link information rather than ask who or where.
Noun-modifying clauses and relative–correlative clauses

Place a modifier before its noun: नेपाल जाने मान्छे, a person who goes to Nepal; हिजो आएको मान्छे, a person who came yesterday. In जो यहाँ बस्छ, ऊ मेरो साथी हो, जो introduces a person and ऊ resumes that person. A clause describes an event/state. Each clause uses the case marking and verb appropriate to its own role.

Meaning and sentence construction

Report speech with its content followed by a form such as भने or भनिन्.
